stage: bounded toy solver screening, declared before smoke
input_law: independent uniform nonzero scalar multiples of the fixture generator
solver: CryptoMiniSat, one thread, fresh solver per query, chained S3, exact subgroup leaf filtering and signed group replay
primary_metric: charged cold collection seconds to full coefficient rank
censoring: retain every empty, query-capped and time-capped stream; no completed-runtime ratio for incomplete pairs
accounting: include fresh fixture, encoding, input generation, failed attempts, solver loading, solving, lift rejection, group replay and rank; oracle and independent verification are separate QA
limits: No imported target, full-width execution, logarithm extraction or rho speedup claim
timing_claim: screen only; three input seeds are not repeated timing confidence intervals
